text: Provides secure sandboxed execution environments (Devboxes) for running code safely
quote: Runloop provides secure sandboxed execution environments called Devboxes.

text: CLI can build a custom sandbox image/blueprint from a Dockerfile
Offers optimized public prebuilt blueprints for common environments
quote: Runloop provides optimized public prebuilt blueprints for common environments.

text: Snapshots save a Devbox's disk state and can be used to create new Devboxes from that saved state
quote: Snapshots can be used to save the current disk state of a Devbox, and to create new Devboxes from a previously saved state.

text: Devbox tunnels expose ports securely over a simple public URL
quote: Let’s use devbox tunnels to securely access ports on your devbox over a simple url.

text: CLI can submit a benchmark job that auto-provisions devboxes, runs agents, scores results, and compares agents side-by-side
quote: Submit a benchmark job via the CLI and let Runloop handle everything: provisioning devboxes, running agents, scoring results, and aggregating outputs. Compare multiple agents side-by-side with a single command.

text: Can run agents against well-known open-source benchmarks like Terminal Bench 2 and AIME
quote: Run your agent against well-known open source benchmarks like terminal bench 2, AIME, and more.

text: Official CLI (rli) offers both an interactive terminal UI and traditional CLI commands for managing resources
quote: The Runloop CLI (`rli`) provides both an interactive terminal UI and traditional CLI commands for managing your Runloop resources.

text: CLI can open a secure SSH shell session directly into a devbox, handling key setup automatically
quote: From the interactive menu, select a devbox and choose **SSH** to open a secure shell session directly into your devbox. The CLI handles all the SSH key setup and connection details automatically.

text: Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) without ever exposing the underlying API keys
quote: Agent Gateways let your agents call LLM APIs like Anthropic and OpenAI **without ever seeing your API keys**.

text: Supports creating custom scorers to evaluate agents on dimensions like security, cost, performance, and compliance
quote: Create custom scorers to evaluate agents across multiple dimensions, such as security, cost, performance, and compliance.
